comments.body: Closed: deferred until a divergence was seen, and none has been in two months, across herdr and muster-daemon. Reopen with the first sighting.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Structural gaps leave no evidence at all - nothing reports a pane created and closed while a subscription was down - so periodic re-snapshot is the only detector (architecture.md, event model). The mirror already rebuilds on every reconnect; what is missing is a timer for the case where the connection never drops but the daemon and the mirror have diverged anyway.

Cheap to do: session.snapshot costs 0.7ms. The question is the interval, and whether constant traffic is worth guarding a divergence nobody has observed. Deferred deliberately until there is a reason to think it happens.
title: 🔌 Reconciliation cadence: how often to re-snapshot
